permissionManager.title: Permission manager
permissionManager.description: Give people additional access within their church scope, with clear ownership and an expiry date.
permissionManager.empty: No permission grants match these filters.
permissionManager.loadError: Could not load permissions. Please try again.
permissionManager.chooseHint: Search the church directory, then choose who should receive additional access.
permissionManager.roleIncluded: Already included in this user’s role
permissionManager.unchanged: Extra permissions do not change the user’s role or the churches they can access.
permissionManager.reasonHint: Explain why this access is needed. This is kept in the history.
permissionManager.revokeHint: This stops the extra access. Permissions already included in the user’s role remain available.
permissionManager.self: You cannot change your own permissions.
permissionManager.noAssignable: No additional permissions are available for you to grant to this user.
permissionManager.expiresBy: Your authority for this permission ends on {date}.
permissionManager.reasonRequired: Please enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
permissionManager.chooseRequired: Choose at least one additional permission.
permissionManager.dateRequired: Choose an expiry in the future.
permissionManager.pausedHint: Needs review means the user’s role or church scope changed. Renew access after reviewing the new scope.
permissionManager.history: History is retained for accountability. Renewing a grant replaces its earlier version.
permissionManager.error: Could not save this change. Please try again.
